changes: Guard native Close and stale callbacks while draft admission, queued close or retained ownership is pending.
Guard local account/draft entry and require settled release before a new local owner.
Use the explicit account-release retry for both ordinary failed-close owners and retained navigation owners.
Stage cache observations before exact selected-record CAS and final draft-owner adoption.
On Disconnect/dispose, preserve admission-owned observer handles and one captured close attempt; strict cleanup drains it once and retains failure for explicit retry.
regression_coverage: Pending factory/load after ordinary Disconnect cannot hide Mail or open local account/draft views; successful release restores these actions.
Queued ordinary close failure blocks Close/local entry and requires explicit release retry.
Selected CAS failure after cache observation retains a failed observer and the unadopted draft owner.
A staged observer that never emits its first snapshot is cancelled once at Disconnect, with no automatic failed-close retry.
Forced disposal drains the staged observer and candidate once.
Existing native identity, cross-provider router, observer/receipt and stale-callback regressions.
scope: Focused development receipt. The later combined frozen-source qualification supersedes this run for final acceptance. Only sampled source hashes are compared here.
